name: Fourth People
description: A civilization in Ixalan's core before the Oltec, to which the mortal who became Aclazotz belonged.

description_citations.text: "Aclazotz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A mortal of the Fourth People, afraid of death, slaughters his people, drinks their blood, and kills the final god as it emerges, becoming the bat god Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: As the final god emerged, he killed it and drank its divinity, becoming a horrific bat god with dominion over the border between life and death.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Birth of a betrayer god". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
